import csv
from collections import defaultdict
ids = {
 'Chiller02':'6041ce4e-9251-5a23-9103-a13dcc247d28',
 'HWPump02':'af4b8334-3dca-548d-b215-2cb64a0aa2c0',
 'SupplyFan_AHU03':'d8a9536c-e875-5be1-90c1-dcfdcb016492',
}
pername=defaultdict(list)
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    r=csv.reader(f); next(r)
    for tsid,ts,val in r:
        if tsid in ids.values():
            name=[k for k,v in ids.items() if v==tsid][0]
            pername[name].append((ts,val))
for n in ids:
    v=pername[n]
    print(n, 'rows',len(v), 'first', v[0] if v else None, 'last', v[-1] if v else None)
